dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly falcate trailing edge with a deep concave spline originating from the apex and extending to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute classification with a small-radius rounded vertex at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55-degree angular steepness relative to the visible horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Broad base-to-height ratio estimated at approximately 1.4:1 based on visible pixel dimensions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive depigmented white mottling and irregular circular patches distributed across the lateral surface of the fin and the dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast 'salt-and-pepper' pigmentation pattern concentrated on the upper half of the dorsal fin silhouette.
